description.p: FeedLizard is a native RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed reader built for Linux. It keeps subscriptions and reading state locally, works offline, and requires no account.
Browse unread, starred, feed, and folder views; search your library; manage OPML subscriptions; and read articles using carefully typeset Scroll and Pages modes.
FeedLizard Linux 0.9.0 Beta 2 improves reading, feed discovery, images, dates, navigation, and distribution readiness.
